items.description: "Jagdishan's decision is incrementally positive as it removes one binary uncertainty," analysts at Nomura said in a note post the development.

items.description: Despite today's sharp rise, Ashoka Buildcon's share price remains 40 per cent below its 52-week high of ₹214.35 scaled in November last year.

items.description: The changes are closely watched by investors as MSCI indices are tracked by global institutional and passive funds, potentially triggering portfolio rebalancing and changes in stock-specific flows.

items.title: Augmont Enterprises shares make a strong market debut, list at 22% premium
items.description: Augmont Enterprises shares listed at ₹956 on the BSE, a premium of 21.32 per cent against the offer price of ₹168. Meanwhile, on the National Stock Exchange, debuted at ₹961, up 21.95 per cent.

items.title: Why has HDFC Bank stock rallied over 2% in Monday's trade? Analysts take
items.description: Analysts at Jefferies believe that uncertainty can drag EPS & valuations, but after a 27% fall year-to-date at 1.5x PB, the risk-reward for HDFC Bank stock seems balanced.

items.title: HDFC Bank: DIIs, public investors keep faith even as stock underperforms
items.description: Analysts said that the rise in DIIs' stake in HDFC Bank was backed by sustained buying from mutual funds. The overall MF holdings increased to 26.5% in June 2026, from 22.5% in the Sept 2025 quarter

items.title: Asian shares slide as US-Iran fighting lifts oil; rate hike bets rise
items.description: Asian stocks fell as renewed US-Iran fighting pushed Brent crude above $90 a barrel, while hawkish Fed signals lifted bets on a September rate hike

items.title: Dollar holds near two-week high as bets rise on September Fed rate hike
items.description: The dollar held firm near a two-week high after Kevin Warsh's hawkish remarks lifted expectations of a September rate hike, while the yen slipped below 160 per dollar

items.title: MSCI rebalancing threatens to turn 'messy' in India's new closing auction
items.description: India's new closing auction system will face its biggest test on Monday as MSCI rebalancing sends about $5 billion in passive-fund trades through markets, raising liquidity concerns
